description: A wide programme-by-month workbook with three note rows, merged two-level quarter headers, mixed zero markers, and a portfolio summary.

questions.question: Using only the programme detail rows (not the PORTFOLIO TOTAL row), what was total spend from April through September 2025, in INR? Treat '-', '–', and blanks as zero.
questions.trap: The title rows and two header levels offset the table, while including PORTFOLIO TOTAL doubles the result.

questions.question: For programme rows whose Lead State is Maharashtra, what was total Q1 FY 2025–26 spend (April, May, and June), in INR? Treat '-', '–', and blanks as zero.
questions.trap: A flat one-row header import can lose the quarter-to-month relationship or mistake notes for headers.

questions.question: How many programme detail rows reported spending greater than zero in August 2025? Treat '-', '–', and blanks as zero and exclude PORTFOLIO TOTAL.
questions.trap: Counting the summary row or nonnumeric zero markers inflates the programme count.

questions.question: Which programme had the highest total spend across April through September 2025? Use programme detail rows only and treat '-', '–', and blanks as zero.
questions.trap: The merged quarter headers can shift month columns if they are read as an ordinary single header row.

questions.question: What percentage of total April–September spend occurred in Q2 FY 2025–26 (July, August, and September)? Use detail rows only, treat zero markers as zero, and report to two decimal places.
questions.trap: Using the displayed row totals together with month values doubles the denominator.

questions.question: Which Funding Partner supported the highest combined April–September spend across its programme detail rows? Treat zero markers as zero and exclude PORTFOLIO TOTAL.
questions.trap: Reading from row 1 or grouping the portfolio summary as a programme obscures the funding-partner totals.
